source: Dinner, lunch and drink picks from OpenTable's Sacramento date-night, kid-friendly, cocktail-bar and wine-bar lists, with coordinates from each OpenTable restaurant page; attractions from Wikipedia and California State Parks (parks.ca.gov) (Nov 2026)

spots.name: Old Sacramento State Historic Park
spots.blurb: Gold Rush-era riverfront district with wooden sidewalks, historic buildings, shops and the riverfront.
spots.blurbEs: Distrito ribereño de la época de la Fiebre del Oro, con aceras de madera, edificios históricos, tiendas y el malecón.

spots.name: California State Railroad Museum
spots.blurb: Restored locomotives and rail cars in a big hall at the north end of Old Sacramento. Open 10am–5pm; $6 youth, free for 5 and under.
spots.blurbEs: Locomotoras y vagones restaurados en una gran sala en el extremo norte de Old Sacramento. Abierto de 10am a 5pm; $6 jóvenes, gratis para menores de 5 años.

spots.name: Crocker Art Museum
spots.blurb: Sacramento's major art museum, a few blocks south of Old Sacramento. $8 youth, free for 5 and under.
spots.blurbEs: El principal museo de arte de Sacramento, a pocas cuadras al sur de Old Sacramento. $8 jóvenes, gratis para menores de 5 años.

spots.name: Capitol Park & State Capitol
spots.blurb: Ten blocks of gardens and memorials around the California State Capitol, which houses the State Capitol Museum.
spots.blurbEs: Diez cuadras de jardines y monumentos alrededor del Capitolio de California, que alberga el State Capitol Museum.

spots.name: Sutter's Fort State Historic Park
spots.blurb: Reconstructed 1840s adobe fort that was a key stop for early overland settlers. Open 10am–5pm; $3 youth, free for 5 and under.
spots.blurbEs: Fuerte de adobe de la década de 1840 reconstruido, parada clave de los primeros colonos que llegaban por tierra. Abierto de 10am a 5pm; $3 jóvenes, gratis para menores de 5 años.
